items.grounds: Re-derived from bytes, every Hebrew run spliced from verse_map_oshb.json at byte tier. oshb:Prov.19.7 opens כָּ֥ל (0-based token 0 of 14, counting the inline ketiv), a quantifier, not a particle; the a-fortiori pair אַ֤ף כִּ֣י stands at 0-based tokens 4-5, and the atnach (U+0591) sits on מִמֶּ֑נּוּ, so the pair governs the move from כָּ֥ל אֲחֵי רָ֨שׁ שְֽׂנֵאֻ֗הוּ ('all the brothers of a poor man hate him') to אַ֤ף כִּ֣י מְ֭רֵעֵהוּ רָחֲק֣וּ מִמֶּ֑נּוּ ('how much more do his companions keep far from him'), web:Prov.19.7 “how much more do his friends avoid him!” - the intensified term is the companions, INSIDE 19:7.
